title: sieve_admin list_scripts response built with manual format!() instead of serde
description: smtp/src/sieve_admin.rs:113-124: JSON response is constructed as format!(r#"{"name":{:?},"active":{}}"", name, active). This is fragile: script names with backslashes or Unicode escapes will produce malformed JSON if :? escaping diverges from JSON escaping rules. Rewrite: define struct ListScriptResponse { name: String, active: bool } with #[derive(Serialize)], return Vec<ListScriptResponse> via axum Json<> extractor.
